shape.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. Defines the shape of the output tensor.
constraints: A `Tensor`. Defines the shape of the output tensor.
shape must be one of int32, int64
The shape of the output tensor must be defined by the provided `shape` parameter.
If `shape` is a single integer, it represents a new scalar or vector. If `shape` is a tuple, it defines the new dimensions of the tensor.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `tensor`.
